propositions: Two dependabot PRs (#129 setup-uv v9→v10, #130 uv-lock botocore/json-repair patches) must be landed as a single Gerrit change.
Setup-uv v10.0.0 pins across 19 sites in 11 workflow files require SHA replacement; v10's breaking cache-disable does not affect rebar workflows since all pass enable-cache: true explicitly.

Botocore 1.43.70 and json-repair 0.63.1 patch bumps are safe and admitted by existing pyproject.toml constraint floors; uv lock --upgrade-package may resolve past the PR versions, requiring exact pins to stay within certified scope.

All workflow files must remain valid YAML; uv lock --check must pass; make lint and make typecheck must exit 0; targeted usage-surface tests (test_structured, test_silent_success, test_llm_capabilities) must pass against the bumped tree.
